items.title: Chuck Findley interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 6, 2023

ctx.x: I have to tell you that you know you made me think, I’ll tell our viewers that we had a 2:00 my time appointment for the Zoom and you dinged me at ten of. And I got this flash of Joe Wilder. You know Joe?

Well he just said this thing, he was so meticulous and such a pro and he talked about how it’s better to be an hour early than a minute late and the whole thing. And anyway that was just an aside. But thanks for the memory, ‘cause I got to know Joe pretty well. I had something I wanted to share with you. I’ve been fortunate to have sessions with a lot of your colleagues.
